title: Works good, water tastes great, slower than anything I've ever seen.
text: Works good, water tastes great, slower than anything I've ever seen.. Takes a long time just to get a couple cups worth of water out of it. You can only put in a few ounces of water in it's chamber in the middle and it slowly drips drips drips to filter it. It's definitely set up right and I rinsed the filters well, it's just SLOWER than molasses! That being said, it does a decent job with filtration but doesn't give you the sharp tasting water like you get from the zero water filters and the reverse osmosis ones. I really like the taste of the water from this one! It's easy to use, very stylish looking, and works well. Just dunno why it takes FOREVER to filter water in this one. Fix that and you have a perfect filter!
